A magical first evening in HCM
May 2026 • Family
This magical place was so much fun to find. I brought my mam on her first night in HCM and the experience of getting to the bar was a source of great excitement. The bar itself is tiny but it only adds to the charm. There were two bartenders that evening, who introduced themselves as Bob and Kevin. They were both so helpful when giving advice about the cocktails and they crafted them exactly to our taste. My mam thoroughly enjoyed the Mekong margarita and I had a Bespoke cocktail made from Mezcal which was absolutely gorgeous. They made sure we knew the prices before making the drinks aswell. It was clear that they are masters of their craft and they chatted easily with us for the evening. A wonderful experience. Thankyou so much!

Hidden Gem Alert: Climb - Hidden Cocktails Bar, Ho Chi Minh City
Jan 2025 • Couples
Climb is an absolute must-visit for cocktail enthusiasts in Ho Chi Minh City. 🥂✨ This hidden bar requires a bit of a journey—climbing several flights of stairs and navigating through a quirky entrance—but the reward is well worth it.

From the moment you step inside, you'll be charmed by the cozy ambiance and multiple seating areas that make you feel right at home. The mixologists here are very talented and creative. Although there is a menu, they take pride in crafting personalized drinks with unique twists. I requested a mojito, and they added their special touch, making it both familiar and refreshingly different. My partner's classic dry martini was also exceptional.

The atmosphere is delightful, and the service really good. If you're looking for a memorable cocktail experience in Saigon, Climb is the place to be. It's definitely worth the climb! 🍸💫

(Also posted to my food blog on Instagram @AbbeyKing16)

Best cocktail bar I’ve been to in Asia with a focus on Whiskey
Feb 2020 • Solo
One of the cocktail bars I’ve been to in Asia. They know how to make a proper cocktail. I was able to get a well made old fashioned using Japanese Whisky. The owner, Jerry, I believe his name is, hooked it up using the Special Nikka Whiskey from the Barrell. The bar had a great vibe, awesome music (read 90s-2000’s hip hop/ alternative), and the owner was awesome to talk to. His background with cocktails and appreciation is unlike anywhere I’ve seen in Asia. He knows his stuff and appreciates good Whiskey. He was very chill and awesome to talk to. The place is really hidden. You will see a sign outside, but you will think you’re walking in to someone’s house/apartment. Once you go up to the 3rd floor, you’ll see a vending machine door as the entrance and the whole ambiance changes. If you’re in Saigon and appreciate a good cocktail, this is a must go to place. Next time I go to Saigon, I’m definitely coming back.
